definitions.explanation: Pitifully bad; causing or deserving pity; very unhappy.

{惨|みじ}め⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧{惨|みじ}め⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I hate living such a wretched life.

notes:
{惨|みじ}め is a na-adjective describing a miserable, wretched, or pathetic state.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {惨|みじ}め⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (wretched life)
- Adverb: {惨|みじ}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (fail miserably)
- Noun form: {惨|みじ}めさ (wretchedness)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {惨|みじ}め⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧: miserable feeling
- {惨|みじ}め⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: pitiful result
- {惨|みじ}め⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: wretched appearance
- {惨|みじ}め⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to feel miserable

USAGE:
Strongly negative. Can describe:
- Situations: {惨|みじ}め⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧
- Feelings: {惨|みじ}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become miserable)
- Self-reflection: often used about oneself during difficult times

SIMILAR:
- ⟦{哀|あわ}れ→哀れ：01775_aware⟧: pitiful, pathetic
